intent.one_liner: Stats: Order volume and average order value by sales channel
intent.brief: Compares the direct and distributor channels over a chosen period: how many orders each one produced, the revenue behind them and the average order value, excluding cancelled orders. Users vary the period and occasionally restrict it to one state. The only breakdown dimension is the customer's channel type.

sql: SELECT c.channel_type AS channel_type, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id) AS order_count, SUM(o.total_amount) AS total_revenue_aud, AVG(o.total_amount) AS average_order_value_aud FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.id WHERE o.order_date >= '2025-08-23' AND o.status <> 'cancelled' AND c.state IN ('NSW', 'QLD', 'SA', 'VIC', 'WA') GROUP BY c.channel_type ORDER BY total_revenue_aud DESC

filters.hint: Filter mapping: the earliest order date to include. Map phrases like "last 12 months", "since 2026-01-01", "year to date", "this year", "last quarter", "past 90 days". Value format must be a single date YYYY-MM-DD. Resolve relative phrases to absolute dates anchored at 2026-08-23 (e.g. last 12 months -> 2025-08-23; year to date -> 2026-01-01; past 90 days -> 2026-05-25). Valid data window is 2024-09-01 to 2026-08-23; clamp to it. This is a >= lower bound only — no upper bound can be added by this template. DEFAULT: keep the default when the user gives no time frame. DISABLE: only if the user explicitly asks for all time / no date filter.

This filter excludes exactly one order status via <>. Allowed values (use one verbatim, reject anything else): cancelled (voided), completed (fulfilled), paid (payment received), pending (awaiting processing), shipped (dispatched). Map "exclude cancelled" (the default), "ignore voided orders", "exclude shipped" etc. by setting the single value. DEFAULT: keep cancelled. DISABLE: only if the user explicitly wants every status counted, including cancelled. This template cannot be switched to an inclusion list (e.g. "only completed") — refuse that instead.

Restricts which states' customers are counted. Allowed values ONLY: NSW, VIC, QLD, SA, WA (use the abbreviation). Map "in New South Wales", "the eastern states", "NSW and VIC only" to the matching subset; reject territories or cities, which this database does not carry. DEFAULT: keep all five, i.e. the whole country. DISABLE: not needed. Note this filters by state but does NOT break the numbers down by state — that is a different intent.

outputs.hint: Output: direct (own sales team) or distributor (sold through a partner). This is the breakdown dimension — keep it unless the user wants one combined row, in which case drop group by g_channel_type too.
Output: number of distinct orders in that channel. Keep by default.
Output: sum of order totals in AUD for that channel. Keep by default.
Output: mean order total in AUD for that channel — the figure that shows distributor orders are larger than direct ones. Keep it whenever the user says "average"; drop if they only asked for totals.

groupbys.hint: Dimension: one row per channel. Dropping it merges both channels into a single total — only do that when the user explicitly asks for the combined number, and drop the matching output as well.
